title: The Election is Over, Now What?
description:
What Happens to the Housing Market After an Election?

The 2024 elections are over—now what? If you’re wondering how the election results impact the housing market, you’re not alone. Whether you’re a homebuyer, seller, or investor, understanding the potential shifts in real estate after an election is crucial. From interest rates and market activity to tax changes and new housing policies, there’s a lot to consider.

In this video, we dive into how the housing market typically reacts post-election, including potential interest rate adjustments, consumer confidence shifts, and tax changes. If you're thinking about buying or selling, staying informed and prepared is essential.
